name: Real-world drone footage AI training dataset

mentions.name: Real-world drone footage AI training dataset
mentions.description: This project builds AI training datasets from real-world drone footage scraped from public sources, addressing the scarcity of real drone data as Europe develops anti-drone systems. It includes automated pipelines to filter and process the scraped footage into material that trains well.
mentions.problem: Everyone in Europe is building anti-drone systems and nobody has real data; lots of companies operate on synthetic data only.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Training AI models on videos of drones scrapped from public sources. Everyone in Europe is building ani drone systems and nobody has real data. Lots of companies operating on synthetics only.

Lots of work to automatically filter and process scraped footage into something that will train well.
